fields.label: Connector
fields.description: The Jarvis Connector this sign-in configuration belongs to. One per connector row (the DocType name IS this value), and the Jarvis Connector's own mcp_oauth_client link must point back at it.

fields.label: Registration Mode
fields.description: How this client obtained its client_id. "dcr": the sign-in service supported self-registration and issued one at setup. "static": an administrator registered Jarvis at the provider by hand and pasted the credentials in (client_id is empty until they do).

fields.label: Client ID
fields.description: The OAuth client identifier this bench presents to the sign-in service. Empty on a static-mode client until an administrator supplies one. Not a secret.

fields.label: Client Secret
fields.description: The OAuth client secret, stored encrypted. Optional: the dynamic-registration path asks for a public client (no secret), and a provider that issues one anyway has it captured here. Never returned by any API; read only via get_password server-side.

fields.label: Registration Access Token
fields.description: The RFC 7591 registration access token a self-registration response returned, stored encrypted. Kept so a later phase can read or delete this registration at the provider; never sent anywhere today.

fields.label: Issuer
fields.description: The sign-in service's own identifier, taken from its validated metadata (it must equal the URL that metadata was fetched from). Recorded here because the authorization response's iss parameter is checked against it on the way back, before any token is requested.

fields.label: Authorization Endpoint
fields.description: Where the browser is sent to sign in. Always https, validated at discovery.

fields.label: Token Endpoint
fields.description: Where authorization codes are exchanged and tokens refreshed. Always https, validated at discovery. This is the ONLY host a code or refresh token is ever sent to.

fields.label: Registration Endpoint
fields.description: The self-registration endpoint, when the sign-in service advertised one. Empty means static mode.

fields.label: Resource
fields.description: The connector's canonical address (no trailing slash), sent as the resource indicator on every authorize, token and refresh request so the issued token is bound to THIS connector and cannot be replayed at another. Tokens are checked against it before use.

fields.label: Scope
fields.description: The permissions Jarvis asks for: what the connector's own challenge named, else everything its sign-in service advertised.

fields.label: Issuer Parameter Supported
fields.description: Whether the sign-in service declared that it returns an iss parameter on the authorization response. When set, a response WITHOUT one is rejected.

fields.label: Discovered At
fields.description: When the endpoints above were discovered and validated.

fields.label: Metadata Snapshot
fields.description: The sign-in service's full metadata document as fetched and validated at setup. Kept so the flow can be rebuilt without re-fetching from a host the connector's own URL chose. Server-set only.
